_comment: OpenTAI's own papers. The team asked to replace the site's papers with the two survey lists, on the understanding that their own work already appears there — but CALM, DAO and UMK appear in neither list, so dropping the old section outright would have removed them from OpenTAI's own site. All six are merged into the library instead; the three that are already in a survey list dedupe against it. Titles, venues and links were verified earlier in the pipeline from the projects' repositories.
